title: Establish graceful button fallback and token boundary for cancelable loading
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Background: After the recent token consolidation (token-migration-2026) several button variants exhibit unexpected visual shifts and ambiguous interaction when entering a loading state. Icon-only buttons sometimes lose their visible touch affordance, primary/ghost combos show spinner color fallthrough in high-contrast themes, and RTL layouts occasionally misplace the spinner relative to caret/chevrons.

Goal: Define a stable, accessible, and implementation-friendly pattern for "cancelable" loading and graceful fallbacks across button variants and themes, and draw a clear token boundary so engineering can avoid regression loops when theme tokens change.

Scope: icon buttons, compact/comfortable scales, primary/secondary/ghost variants, loading/disabled transitions, RTL alignment, and theme-aware spinner contrast. This ticket focuses on the design decisions, acceptance criteria, and handoff artifacts; implementation is tracked as dependent ENG work.

Decisions and proposals:
- Introduce an explicit visual state "deferred-loading" for quick server delays (<350ms): subtle progress indicator without replacing label, to avoid layout shift.
- Default loading behavior remains "replace-content" for destructive/confirm actions; add a new property in the component API (design spec) called "cancelable: boolean". Cancelable flows show a spinner as an overlay with a visible cancel affordance (X) and maintain original label when possible.
- Tokens: establish token boundary rules in Confluence (link below): component-level tokens (button-gap, icon-gap, spinner-size, spinner-contrast) must not inherit brand-level color tokens directly; instead use semantic tokens (surface-foreground, interactive-contrast) so theme swaps don’t unexpectedly change spinner size/visibility.
- Icon density: standardize icon hit target to 40px for compact and 48px for comfortable; provide CSS token --button-interactive-size to let runtime honor Dedicated/Private scaling.
- Spinner placement: prefer leading placement for left-to-right and trailing for RTL when loading replaces content; for overlay/cancelable mode spinner should be centered over label and include an explicit cancel affordance visually distinguishable at 3:1 contrast.
- Motion: prefer reduced motion-friendly micro-transitions; spinner fade-in 80ms, fade-out 120ms.

Accessibility notes:
- Cancelable loading must expose an accessible name that includes "loading" state and the cancel action as a button with aria-label="Cancel action".
- Ensure keyboard focus remains on button and that Esc triggers cancel when cancelable=true.
- Provide a tokenized focus outline that remains visible against high-contrast themes.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Figma frames for all variants updated with annotated behavior (compact/comfortable, icon-only, text+icon, primary/ghost/neutral).
2) Component spec with new props (cancelable:boolean, loadingMode:{deferred|replace|overlay}, spinnerPlacement:{leading|trailing|center}) delivered to ENG.
3) Token boundary doc completed with list of component tokens vs theme tokens.
4) QA checklist with RTL screenshots and contrast tests (against design-system QA harness).
5) E2E tests to assert no layout shift for deferred-loading and full keyboard cancel path for cancelable flows.

Handoff artifacts:
- Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/REDACTED/button-loading-fallback-2026 (frames: 12-25)
- Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DS/pages/Token+Boundary+Guidelines (section: Button token boundaries)
- GitHub PR (implementation reference): https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-ui/pull/7123

Notes about regressions we've seen:
- Token fallthrough caused spinner color to match link color in dark-high-contrast theme (UX reported by QA on 2026-02-12).
- Icon-only compact lost visual hitbox when spinner overlay used replace-content behavior (observed on mobile viewport).
- RTL caret + trailing spinner overlap (reported by localization team).

Recommended prioritization: High. The regressions are visible in customer-facing flows and affect keyboard users and RTL locales. This is a design-driven fix with an engineering dependency (ENG-5021) and should ship with the next design-system minor release.
comments: 2026-02-19 Maya Chen: Ran initial audit across existing button frames; captured 22 failing permutations (compact/icon-only x themes x RTL). Uploaded screenshots to Figma comments.

2026-02-23 Arjun Patel: Drafted component API changes and proposed cancelable flag. Shared implementation constraints: we need an onCancel callback and a signal to routing layer to abort network request when possible. Linking ENG ticket ENG-5021.

2026-02-27 Design review: PM (Ana Soto) requested that default behavior remains conservative to avoid surprising existing customers. Decided to default cancelable=false; explicitly opt-in for flows that can be safely retried.
2026-03-03 Accessibility review (Lukas Meyer): Confirmed aria pattern and Esc mapping. Requested explicit examples in spec for screen reader announcement sequence when cancelling mid-load.

2026-03-05 QA findings (Rita Gomez): Deferred-loading eliminated layout shift in 10/10 desktop screenshots; mobile still requires spinner overlay tweaks for compact icon-only—recommend increase icon gap token by 4px for compact.

2026-03-08 Engineering comment (ENG-5021): Implemented token boundary migration flag and introduced new CSS vars: --rw-button-icon-gap, --rw-button-interactive-size, --rw-button-spinner-size. Minor visual diffs in dark theme fixed by mapping spinner-contrast to semantic interactive-contrast.
2026-03-10 Arjun Patel: Created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-ui/pull/7123 with unit tests; screenshots attached. Requesting design review before merging to staging.

2026-03-12 Maya Chen: Reviewed PR; left Figma link to updated frames and asked for one small tweak on cancel affordance contrast. Marking ticket In Review and adding release tag design-system-2026.03.
Next steps: resolve contrast tweak, add E2E cancel test, confirm release notes copy, coordinate with localization for RTL verification.
